acquisition_method.evidence: The Orbitrap Astral mass spectrometer was operated in the data-independent acquisition (DIA) mode with the scanning range of 100–1700 m/z.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Thereafter, proteins were alkylated with iodoacetamide (IAM) at a concentration of 40 mM in darkness at room temperature for an additional duration of 40 min.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Thereafter, proteins were alkylated with iodoacetamide (IAM) at a concentration of 40 mM in darkness at room temperature for an additional duration of 40 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin was introduced to the solution at a 1:50 mass ratio of trypsin to protein and incubated overnight at 37 °C.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Digested protein products were separated by the Thermo Scientific Vanquish Neo UHPLC system which was directly interfaced with the Orbitrap Astral mass spectrometer.
